dataset: King of AEO Experiment: AI answer observations
description: Observations of which names Google AI Overview and ChatGPT returned for the term King of AEO in Brazil and the United States, September 2026. Weekly US/BR tracking; machine-readable mirror of data.csv.

fields.engine: Answer engine queried, logged out, no personalization
fields.country: Country the query ran from (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
fields.names_returned: Entity names the engine returned for the term King of AEO
fields.source_cited: Whether the engine cited a source (yes/no)
fields.entity_resolved: Whether the engine resolved Allan Oliveira as a distinct entity (yes/no)
